name: Janu Tokyo
insider_take: Tokyo's newest ultra-luxury sanctuary where ancient Japanese aesthetics meet cutting-edge hospitality in the heart of Shibuya.
whats_special: Janu Tokyo occupies floors 38-45 of the iconic Shibuya Sky tower, offering breathtaking views of Mount Fuji on clear days. The hotel features Japan's highest infinity pool and incorporates traditional "omotenashi" service philosophy with contemporary luxury. Each suite showcases handcrafted details by local artisans and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the world's busiest pedestrian crossing.
pro_tip: Book a west-facing suite for spectacular sunset views over Tokyo Bay and potential Mount Fuji sightings, especially clear during winter months.
dont_miss: The rooftop Sky Gallery on the 46th floor offers 360-degree panoramic views, while the hotel's signature restaurant features a live sushi counter with Michelin-trained chefs. The spa's traditional onsen experience uses mineral-rich waters sourced from Mount Fuji's foothills, and you're just steps away from Shibuya Crossing – the world's most famous intersection.
pros: Ultra-modern design with stunning panoramic Tokyo skyline views
Exceptional Japanese hospitality (omotenashi) combined with contemporary luxury
Prime Shibuya location with excellent access to shopping and entertainment
State-of-the-art wellness facilities and innovative dining concepts
cons: Recently opened property with limited guest feedback history
